name: Battle Master
summary: A tactician who fuels battlefield maneuvers with superiority dice.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.short: Learn maneuvers and gain superiority dice (d8).
features.summary: You learn three maneuvers and gain four d8 superiority dice, which you spend to use maneuvers (one per attack). You learn two more maneuvers at 7th, 10th and 15th level, and gain a fifth die at 7th and a sixth at 15th. Dice return on a short or long rest. Save DC = 8 + PB + STR or DEX.

features.name: Student of War
features.summary: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.short: Study a creature for a minute to compare its strengths to yours.
features.summary: If you spend 1 minute observing a creature outside combat, you learn whether it is equal, superior or inferior to you in two characteristics like STR, AC or class levels.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.summary: Your superiority dice turn into d10s. At 18th level they become d12s.

features.name: Relentless
features.short: Regain a superiority die if you have none at initiative.
features.summary: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice left, you regain one.
